rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution the President appoints Viktor Alekseyevich Zubkov Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation; the decree enters into force on the day of signing. Signed "Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин", Moscow, Kremlin, 14 September 2007, No. 1202.
